Class Admissions

java.lang.Object
network.ike.foundation.ike.evaluate.Admissions
public final class Admissions extends Object
The evaluator's dispatch table as the store holds it: for each node kind of the catalog, the construct a checked relation admits it as, and the relation's kind. A node kind absent here is refused at evaluation.
